```{python}
import pandas as pd
import json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from pathlib import Path

# Load training stats
stats_file = Path("../results/training_stats.json")
if stats_file.exists():
    with open(stats_file, 'r') as f:
        data = json.load(f)
    history = pd.DataFrame(data['history'])
else:
    # Dummy data for demonstration if model hasn't run yet
    history = pd.DataFrame({
        'epoch': range(10),
        'loss': [0.6, 0.5, 0.45, 0.42, 0.40, 0.38, 0.37, 0.36, 0.35, 0.34]
    })

sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid")
```

## Training Overview

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Loss Curve
```{python}
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 4))
sns.lineplot(data=history, x='epoch', y='loss', marker='o')
plt.title("Training Loss over Epochs")
plt.xlabel("Epoch")
plt.ylabel("Binary Cross-Entropy Loss")
plt.show()
```

### Model Config
```{python}
if stats_file.exists():
    config = data['config']
    print(f"**Model Name**: {data['config']['name']}")
    print(f"**Hidden Layers**: {config['model']['hidden_dims']}")
    print(f"**Batch Size**: {config['training']['batch_size']}")
else:
    print("No training stats found. Run the Snakemake pipeline to generate live results.")
```

:::

## Feature Analysis (via DuckDB)

```{python}
import duckdb
parquet_path = "../data/higgs.parquet"

if Path(parquet_path).exists():
    con = duckdb.connect()
    df = con.execute(f"SELECT column0 as label, column1 as feature1 FROM read_parquet('{parquet_path}') LIMIT 10000").df()
    
    plt.figure(figsize=(10, 4))
    sns.kdeplot(data=df, x='feature1', hue='label', fill=True)
    plt.title("Lepton pT Distribution by Label (Subset)")
    plt.show()
else:
    print("Note: Higgs Parquet data not found. Dataset analysis will appear here after the Ingest step.")
```
